card.line: Emmaus was a village about seven miles from Jerusalem, where two disciples were headed when the risen Jesus joined them on the road on the day of His resurrection.

moments.title: Two disciples bound for Emmaus
moments.text: On the day Jesus rose, two of His followers were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem. They talked with each other about everything that had happened.

problems.problem: The place is still labeled a city, although the card text calls it a village.
